diagnostic_steps.action: Parse log stream for DNS timeout events
findings: DNS query timeouts for multiple services (payment-service, api-gateway, redis-cache)
Upstream DNS server 8.8.8.8:53 failing with 10s timeout
CoreDNS ConfigMap configured to forward to 8.8.8.8
DNS stub domain not configured for internal services
Upstream DNS timeout set to 5s (too aggressive)
Root cause: External DNS server 8.8.8.8 experiencing high latency
Contributing factor: CoreDNS forwarding all queries to external DNS
No internal DNS caching for cluster-local services
High cache miss rate indicates poor DNS design
diagnostic_steps.root_cause: CoreDNS forwarding all queries to slow external DNS server without caching

recommendations.rationale: Update CoreDNS ConfigMap to add multiple upstream DNS servers

recommendations.command:
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: coredns
  namespace: kube-system
data:
  Corefile: |
    .:53 {
        errors
        health
        ready
        kubernetes cluster.local in-addr.arpa ip6.arpa {
            pods insecure
            fallthrough in-addr.arpa ip6.arpa
        }
        prometheus :9153
        forward . 8.8.8.8 1.1.1.1 {
            policy sequential
            timeout 10s
        }
        cache 3600
        loop
        reload
        loadbalance
    }
EOF
recommendations.rationale: Apply optimized CoreDNS configuration with caching and multiple upstreams

recommendations.command: kubectl rollout restart deployment coredns -n kube-system
recommendations.rationale: Restart CoreDNS to apply new configuration

recommendations.command: kubectl patch node $(kubectl get nodes -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}') -p '{"spec":{"unschedulable":false}}'
recommendations.rationale: Ensure nodes are schedulable for DNS pod replacement
Consider changing DNS policy for better DNS resolution

remediation_validation: Monitor DNS query latency (should drop below 100ms)
Verify cache hit rate increases above 80%
Test DNS resolution for internal and external services
